description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 20.06.2016 to 26.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
